title: On the Lie Foliation structure of Walker Manifolds
summary: We study Walker manifolds, that is, pseudo-Riemannian manifolds $(M^n,g)$ admitting a null parallel distribution $\D$ of rank $r\leq\frac{n}{2}$. We show that $\D$ always integrates to a $G$-Lie foliation $\F_\D$, where $G$ is the simply connected Lie group with Lie algebra equal to the structure algebra $\g_\D$ of $\D$. The transverse holonomy group of $(M,g)$ coincides with the image of the holonomy morphism $h:π_1(M)\to G$.
